Difftest AudioObjectUpdateDemon_Run (2000 seeds; every 4th builds through the factories, the others the original constructor on 0xc5 memory against ours; random ops through every face: Init / Shutdown (also through the service face's thunks), OnTick with the stopwatch stepping 100 / 250 / 499 / 500 / 501 / 1000 per read around the 500 cap, DoMessage over the sound start 0xaedbce8b, the sound event 0xcc773dd7 (start and stop), 0xb2 / 0xb5, the mode 0xece20be8, the registered but unhandled 0x2e04ed78, an unknown type and a null message, events with or without the event interface, object ids with the high word set and 0, QueryInterface / AddRef / Release on every face, the service accessors, and world changes (objects present by id, the app's world, the state service's lot, the lot scene, the sound renderer, the framework cells); since lane LE every body runs, the monitors' placement update, step and line-of-sight ray and the sounds' update included, against recording fakes of the world's objects (room, level, direction, flags, model), the model and its "root_rot" node (transforms drifting by 0 / 1 / 31 / 32 / -32 / -33 / 4096 ulps or a new rotation, sometimes handed back through a pointer other than the out argument), the view, the lot scene's ray cast, the director's audio events (one in five not made) and the sound renderer; after each op every demon field (never-written bytes included on 0xc5 memory), every monitor and playing sound in list order (their vtables as ours / the game's, the sound's monitor as a list position; a monitor's points once it has been enabled), the framework / renderer / state cells, the fakes' call log with normalised pointers (the ray's points when AimRay aimed it, the events' keys and values, the any's value and type) and every fake's count; the message-id walks, the stopwatch's Elapsed / Restart, game new / delete and the scene graph's node search 0xae7490 / bounding box 0xae7d00 are recording stand-ins). Difftest AudioObjectUpdateDemon_Members (30000 seeds): one monitor and one sound per case, built by the original constructors on 0xc5 memory against ours with every field set by the case (the points 0 / 1 / 31 / 32 / -32 / -33 ulps or far from what is compared, on either sign; the room 0x10000 / 0x20001 / -1, the floor around the demon's, audibility 0 / -0 / 0.5 / 1 / NaN, hidden 0 / 1 / 2, no object / model / lot / view / lot scene / app world), then one member called directly: the placement update 0x22a5ad, Step 0x2299b7, AimRay 0x2296d2 (into a 0xc5 ray, all 8 words compared), the sound's Update 0x22a119, or the helpers 0x229e85 / 0x2297af / 0x229d15 / 0x22ab53 / 0x229f1d; every field of both, the log and the counts compared, then the destructors'. Left out: the bytes the monitor's and sound's constructors never write (allocator garbage on both sides; cited in the test); the ray's points when Step casts a ray AimRay didn't aim (no model: the original builds it inline, its points the frame's leftovers). Mutants (lane LE, tools/mutate.py --filter AudioObjectUpdateDemon, list in notes/feedback/LE.md): 54 over the new bodies (the ULP compare and its operand order, the placement's room test, model drop, disabled path, node / model facing, rotation, moved test, old centre, box centre rounding, transform pointer, 0x5a69d3d5 fallback angle and sign, floor / room widths, distance, hidden bit; AimRay's model test, slot 140's argument, the +0 origin, the direction; Step's view test, room low word, floor compare, ray range, change test, key, step time, the aim; the sound update's disabled drop, each of the five compares, the copies, the event's values, the hidden toggle, gain, fade; the helpers), all valid; final full run after the last test change 54 killed (a first run's one survivor, the box centre as (max + min) * 0.5, is killed since the bounds stand-in writes full-mantissa values).
